toleranceBasis.observerProjectionRelativeY: The existing Bruneton B1 color gate bounds mean relative luminance error at five percent.
toleranceBasis.observerProjectionDeltaUv: The existing Bruneton B1 color gate bounds worst-ray CIE 1976 chromaticity disagreement at 0.005.
toleranceBasis.projectionReference: Each native bin-average radiance is held constant over its declared bin and integrated against the official one-nanometer CIE 1931 2-degree color-matching functions.
